# V1.9.10

Section: Source

**V1.9.10** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on October 31st, 2023.

## V1.9.10

- Fix - compressed gas tanks now fill completely
- Fix - water jets thrust increased to match previous level
- Fix - modular engines now work correctly with inf fuel
